tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full text of one item by the id returned from `search` (product:, service:, project:, resource:<kind>/<slug>, category:, certificate:, company:info).

tools.name: get_brochure
tools.description: Barmaan's public brochure (PDF, no login): download links in English, Persian, Kurdish (Sorani) and Arabic, a short summary of the content, base prices and contact details.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Barmaan contact and company facts: use for the phone number, address, email, WhatsApp, map link, working hours, social profiles, registration details, key site pages, city pages and brochure links.

tools.name: get_dwg_viewer_info
tools.description: Information about Barmaan's free browser DWG/DXF viewer. Files cannot be uploaded through MCP; give the user the link.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full public details of one product: specs, models, documents, FAQ, price/availability. Pass `slug` or the 6-digit `code`.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Full text of one resource (kind + slug from list_resources). Text is capped at 20,000 characters.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Details of one service by slug (from list_services).

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Published technical guides, standards notes, datasheets and glossary entries.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Barmaan's engineering, calibration, inspection and software services.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a price/quote request to Barmaan's sales team (same inbox as the website form). Ask the user for name and phone first; never invent contact details. Call once with confirm=false to get a preview, show it to the user, then call with confirm=true only after they agree.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search all public Barmaan content (products, categories, services, projects, guides, certificates). Returns ids to pass to `fetch`.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Barmaan product catalog (industrial instruments). Prices are published USD prices; price.on_request=true means ask for a quote.

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.description: Check a Barmaan calibration certificate by its exact code. Returns status, equipment, manufacturer and serial only.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_certificate" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_info, request_quote · Private data: get_brochure, get_company_info, get_dwg_viewer_info, get_product, request_quote · Public sink: get_company_info, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_info, request_quote · Private data: get_brochure, get_company_info, get_dwg_viewer_info, get_product, request_quote · Public sink: get_company_info, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
